result.title: Follow the Features: SAE Feature-Guided Data-Efficient Instruction-Tuning of Large Language Models
result.summary: Selecting small, effective instruction-tuning datasets requires identifying which aspects of the original data to retain. We introduce Follow the Features (FtF), a data-selection method that uses sparse autoencoder (SAE) features to characterize training data and guide subset construction. FtF ranks features using dataset-level activation statistics, scores samples by their expression of highly ranked features, and incorporates feature resampling to encourage diversity. The LLM-SAE pair used for selection is independent of the model being fine-tuned, enabling reuse across target models. We evaluate FtF on two model-dataset settings at a training budget of 100 samples with a fixed sequence length of 256 tokens. FtF achieves performance competitive with GRAPE and S2L, with relative rankings varying across settings. On Qwen 3 8B trained on Alpaca, FtF exceeds full-dataset training by 1.59 percentage points in the harmonic mean of an AlpacaEval-based win rate and Open LLM Leaderboard performance, although full-dataset training retains a higher Leaderboard score. These results support SAE feature statistics as a useful signal for data-efficient instruction tuning.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Follow the Features（FtF），用独立于目标模型的 LLM-SAE 对的稀疏自编码器特征激活统计排序特征、给样本打分并配合特征重采样以保持多样性，从而在 100 样本训练预算下选出小型指令微调子集，在两个设置上与 GRAPE、S2L 表现相当。
AI.relevance_reason: 其用 SAE 特征激活统计刻画数据并据此筛选样本的做法，可能与 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、训练样本贡献分配及 latent 状态内容选择有方法层面的借鉴线索，是否迁移到多模态需核查。
